name: Kirby CMS
description: Kirby CMS is a file-based self-hosted content management system for custom websites and digital publishing. It supports pages, content fields, files, drafts, users, roles, languages, blueprints, plugins, a Panel, and a core REST API with read and mutation routes.
agentUseSummary: Relay calls the core individual-page REST endpoint for one preselected page ID with a fixed select projection and returns only ID and publication status. Because Kirby's API also exposes mutations and authenticates as users, Relay requires HTTPS Basic auth from a dedicated non-admin custom role with only page reads enabled and all writes and other resource permissions disabled.

capabilities.label: Read selected page state
capabilities.description: Read one selected page's ID and publication status.

allowed.label: Read selected page state
allowed.description: Use the core individual-page REST endpoint for one selected page ID and return only ID and status.

blocked.label: Expose content or identities
blocked.description: Titles, slugs, URLs, UUIDs, content, custom fields, files, drafts, children, siblings, users, and identities are excluded from Relay output.

blocked.label: Mutate Kirby CMS
blocked.description: Pages, files, users, roles, languages, site settings, blueprints, drafts, changes, and every PATCH, POST, DELETE, or method override are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Kirby CMS access
blocked.description: Other page IDs, page lists, children, files, users, roles, languages, site, system, custom API routes, redirects, and Panel administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Selected Page State Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected page's ID and publication status; content, identities, other resources, administration, and mutations remain blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized public HTTPS Kirby CMS staging site must enable Basic auth and provide a dedicated non-admin custom-role API user with Panel/API access, page reads enabled, every write and other resource permission disabled, one selected page ID, and Fairfax validation.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console lane, create the least-privilege custom role and dedicated user, enable HTTPS-only Basic auth, enter the site URL and selected page ID through Relay, then validate exact-page binding, fixed select projection, content redaction, other-route and mutation denial, redirect and private-DNS denial, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Official Kirby documentation defines GET /api/pages/:id, the select query parameter, and ID and status as selectable page fields.
Official authentication documentation defines HTTPS-only remote HTTP Basic auth and states that API access is governed by user permissions.

Official permissions documentation defines custom-role API access, page read permissions, write permissions, default-allow behavior, and the admin role's unrestricted authority, supporting Relay's dedicated non-admin deny-by-default role requirement.
Official page API documentation requires hierarchy slashes in page IDs to be replaced with plus signs and enumerates the adjacent mutation and child/file routes that Relay blocks.
